aey emaan walo ! Allah aur uss kay Rasool kay aagay naa barha kero ,   aur Allah say dartay raho . Allah yaqeenan sabb kuch sunta , sabb kuch janta hai .

aey emaan walo ! apni aawazen nabi ki aawaz say buland matt kiya kero , aur naa unn say baat kertay huye iss tarah zor say bola kero jaisay tum aik doosray say zor say boltay ho , kahen aisa naa ho kay tumharay aemal barbad hojayen , aur tumhen pata bhi naa chalay .

yaqeen jano jo log Allah kay Rasool ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) kay paas apni aawazen neechi rakhtay hain , yeh wohi log hain jinn kay dilon ko Allah ney khoob janch ker taqwa kay liye muntakhib kerliya hai . unn ko maghfirat bhi hasil hai , aur zabardast ajar bhi .
. ( aey payghumber ! ) jo log tumhen hujron kay peechay say aawaz detay hain , unn mein say aksar ko aqal nahi hai .
aur agar yeh log uss waqt tak sabar kertay jab tak tum khud bahir nikal ker unn kay paas aajatay , to unn kay liye behtar hota , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

aey emaan walo ! agar koi fasiq tumharay paas koi khabar ley ker aaye , to achi tarah tehqeeq kerliya kero ,   kahen aisa naa ho kay tum nadani say kuch logon  ko nuqsan phoncha betho , aur phir apney kiye per pachtao .

aur yeh baat achi tarah samajh lo kay tumharay darmiyan Allah kay Rasool mojood hain . boht si baaten hain jinn mein woh agar tumhari baat maan len to khud tum mushkil mein parr-jao . lekin Allah ney tumharay dil mein emaan ki mohabbat daal di hai , aur ussay tumharay dilon mein purkashish bana diya hai , aur tumharay andar kufr ki aur gunahon aur nafarmani ki nafrat bitha di hai .   aesay hi log hain jo theek theek raastay per aa-chukay hain ,
jo Allah ki taraf say fazal aur naimat ka nateeja hai , aur Allah ilm ka bhi malik hai , hikmat ka bhi malik .

aur agar musalmanon kay do giroh aapas mein larr parren to unn kay darmiyan sulah kerao . phir agar unn mein say aik giroh doosray kay sath ziyadti keray to uss giroh say larro jo ziyadti ker raha ho , yahan tak kay woh Allah kay hukum ki taraf loat aaye . chunacheh agar woh loat aaye , to unn kay darmiyan insaf kay sath sulah kerado , aur ( her moamlay mein ) insaf say kaam liya kero , beyshak Allah insaf kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .
haqeeqat to yeh hai kay tamam musalman bhai bhai hain , iss liye apney do bhaiyon kay darmiyan talluqaat achay banao , aur Allah say daro takay tumharay sath rehmat ka moamla kiya jaye .

aey emaan walo ! naa to mard doosray mardon ka mazaq urayen , hosakta hai kay woh ( jinn ka mazaq urra rahey hain ) khud inn say behtar hon , aur naa doosri aurten doosri aurton ka mazaq urayen , hosakta hai kay woh ( jinn ka mazaq urra rahi hain ) khud inn say behtar hon . aur tum aik doosray ko taana naa diya kero , aur naa aik doosray ko buray alqaab say pukaro . emaan laney kay baad gunah ka naam lagna boht buri baat hai .   aur jo log inn baaton say baaz naa ayen , to woh zalim log hain .

aey emaan walo ! boht say gumanon say bacho , baaz gumaan gunah hotay hain .   aur kissi ki toh mein naa lago ,   aur aik doosray ki gheebat naa kero .   kiya tum mein say koi yeh pasand keray ga kay woh apney maray huye bhai ka gosht khaye-? iss say to khud tum nafrat kertay ho ! aur Allah say daro . beyshak Allah bara tauba qubool kernay wala , boht meharban hai .

aey logo ! haqeeqat yeh hai kay hum ney tum sabb ko aik mard aur aik aurat say peda kiya hai , aur tumhen mukhtalif qoamon aur khandano mein iss liye taqseem kiya hai takay tum aik doosray ki pehchan ker-sako .   dar-haqeeqat Allah kay nazdeek tum mein sabb say ziyada izzat wala woh hai jo tum mein sabb say ziyada muttaqi ho . yaqeen rakho kay Allah sabb kuch janney wala , her cheez say ba-khabar hai .

yeh dehaati kehtay hain kay :  hum emaan ley aaye hain .  inn say kaho kay :  tum emaan to nahi laye , albatta yeh kaho kay hum ney hathiyaar daal diye hain .   aur emaan abhi tumharay dilon mein dakhil nahi huwa . aur agar tum waqaee Allah aur uss kay Rasool ki itaat kero gay to Allah tumharay aemal ( kay sawab ) mein zara bhi kami nahi keray ga . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala , boht meharban hai .

emaan laney walay to woh hain jinhon ney Allah aur uss kay Rasool ko dil say maana hai , phir kissi shak mein nahi parray , aur jinhon ney apney maal o dolat aur apni janon say Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya hai . wohi log hain jo sachay hain .

. ( aey payghumber ! inn dehaatiyon say ) kaho kay :  kiya tum Allah ko apney deen ki itlaa dey rahey ho-? halankay Allah unn tamam cheezon ko khoob janta hai jo aasmano mein hain aur jo zameen mein hain , aur Allah her cheez ka poora poora ilm rakhta hai .

yeh log tum per ehsan rakhtay hain kay yeh Islam ley aaye hain . inn say kaho kay :  mujh per apney Islam laney ka ehsan naa jatlao . balkay agar tum waqaee ( apney daway mein ) sachay ho to yeh Allah ka tum per ehsan hai kay uss ney tumhen emaan ki hidayat di .
waqiaa yeh hai kay Allah aasmano aur zameen ki her posheeda baat ko khoob janta hai , aur jo kuch tum kertay ho , Allah ussay achi tarah dekh raha hai .
